scope: ephemeral PostgreSQL17 RPC contract; not hosted PostgREST, grants, Storage or quotas

checks.label: unapplied SQL draft loads in isolated PostgreSQL17
budget draft loads with existing local Storage metadata and a private fixture attestation
anonymous and authenticated callers cannot issue guest tokens
service role creates tokens and persists owned jobs
idempotent retries reuse jobs and changed requests are refused
another token cannot read or claim the job
concurrent claim executes one fenced lease
numeric bytes, staged keys and invalid run timestamps fail with contract errors
lease expiry is rechecked after waiting for a row lock
one global lookup lane admits only one concurrent request
interrupted SQL run is owned, append-only and accepted by workflowView
SQL evidence cap and cleanup tombstones preserve journal references
restart preserves token ownership and job identity
all guest service steps replay a public version through durable SQL
private journal tables and helpers remain inaccessible to the service caller
concurrent duplicate token issuance yields a contract error
retry backoff, attempt budget and read-only polling stay coherent
selected source evidence cannot be replaced by another step
token and evidence expiry remain unavailable without changing preserved exports
expired proof refuses enqueue with no new job row; the service cannot attest capacity
metadata in other buckets and the worst-case envelope fail closed before enqueue
processing egress shares the monthly budget and failed reservations add no ledger row
automatic statement admits within Free-plan room
expired automatic statement refuses admission
orphan sweep removes only old unreferenced guest objects
cleanup waits one hour after terminal
